answers.sommelier_long: "I tend to gravitate toward traditional Rioja Reservas — producers like Ardanza, Muga, and Tondonia are right in my wheelhouse — though I also enjoy the occasional Rhône-style wine. I'm usually comfortable spending around £20–£45 GBP a bottle, so anything with that classic, age-worthy character in that range would be perfect."
